steps.description: Colloidal TiO2 was prepared by dropwise addition of titanium(IV) tetrachloride to water cooled to 4°
TiO2 colloids were diluted to 0.015 M and mixed with 100 µL of glycidil isopropyl ether
With vigorous mixing, 0.2 M LiOH was rapidly injected into the TiO2 solution until a pH of 9.5 was reached.
TiO2 nanoparticles were dialyzed against 10 mM NaH2PO4 until pH 6.5 was obtained.
In the second step, the succinimidyl group is replaced with dopamine through its terminal amino group in the presence of dioxane.
This solution was thoroughly dialyzed against water to remove free dopamine unbound to oligonucleotides.
In the final step, dopamine end-labeled oligonucleotides are bound to TiO2 particles modified by glycidil isopropyl ether.
